text:
zoe: opened PR #5337 to update SDK python snippets and migration note. docs-preview failed: linkcheck (2 anchors) and md-lint line-length. CI: https://ci.redwood.ai/8602

fin-bot: (system) note: repository protection requires 1 approval before merge.

docs-bot: docs-preview failed for PR 5337 — checks: linkcheck (2), md-lint (1). Full log: https://ci.redwood.ai/8602/logs

martin: linkcheck seems flaky on our CI again — it timed out on external docs.test.redwood.ai while local check passed. Any recent CDN changes?

devops-bot: Canary deploy to docs CDN at 2026-03-20 02:15 UTC changed redirect behavior (301 -> 302) for /guides/. This can break strict linkcheck. Ops ticket: OPS-1147

laura: For a quick unblock, replace external links with archived permalinks or our internal mirror. Content change > infra rollback during release window.

maya: I'll patch anchors in the SDK snippets and reflow long lines. Will run `make docs-linkcheck --timeout=30` to match CI behavior.

martin: If CI still flakes, request a rerun with `docs-bot rerun` and ping @eng-infra. Also add a short PR note that linkcheck flake is known.

zoe: pushed commits: update anchors to `#python-client-usage` and `#migration-steps`, wrap prose at 88 cols. Commit msg: "Fix: anchors + wrap sdk prose; note flaky external linkcheck"

devops-bot: ops ticket OPS-1147 updated: deferring CDN redirect change to next maintenance window. Temporary mitigation: allow 3xx on linkcheck.

docs-bot: CI queued — build 8602 restarted

docs-bot: docs-preview success for PR 5337 — all checks passed

laura: approving now. Thanks @maya for the quick patch. :white_check_mark:

martin: merged at 11:42 PT. Follow-up: opening docs-infra ticket to cache or loosen strictness on external targets.

zoe: filing a short post-merge note in the PR about ops ticket and guidance for future external links. :memo:
